liftMark.en: he is patient / she is patient
she is cooperative because she helps others
my brother is taller than me
he is more confident than his brother
she is the girl who wears glasses

liftMark.ar: كَانَ خَجُولًا، أَمَّا الآنَ فَأَصْبَحَ وَاثِقًا
liftMark.en: he used to be shy; now he has become confident

liftMark.ar: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ المَوْضَةَ مُهِمَّةٌ، فَإِنَّ الرَّاحَةَ أَهَمُّ
liftMark.en: although fashion matters, comfort matters more
liftMark.kind: concession · عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ … فَإِنَّ

liftMark.ar: أَفْهَمُ رَأْيَكَ، وَلٰكِنَّنِي لَا أَتَّفِقُ تَمَامًا
liftMark.en: I understand your view, but I don’t fully agree
